            The Book of Armaments: Chapter 2 verses 9 to 21.

...And St. Attila raised the Hand Grenade up on high, saying...
'O Lord, bless this, thy Hand Grenade, that with it thou mayst blow
thine enemies to tiny bits, in thy mercy.'
And the Lord did grin, and the people did feast upon the lambs,
and sloths, and carp, and anchovies, and orangotans, and
breakfast cereals, and fruit bats, and lice....

And the Lord spake, saying 'First shall thou take out the holy pin,
then shall thou count to three, no more, no less.
Three shall be the number thou shall count,
and the number of the counting shall be three.
Four shall thou not count, nor thou shall countest to two,
excepting that thou shall then proceed to three. Five is right out.
Once the number three, being the third number been reached,
then lobest thou thy Holy Handgrenade of Antioch towards thy foe,
who being naughty in my sight, shall snuff it.'

                                AMEN

[b]The Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch – Rabbit of Caerbannog[/b]
This mod adds the [b]Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch[/b] as a powerful trinket that summons the legendary [b]Rabbit of Caerbannog[/b] as your combat companion. Inspired by [i]Monty Python and the Holy Grail[/i], this rabbit is small, fluffy, and [b]absurdly lethal[/b]. Once equipped, the rabbit follows you and waits patiently for the perfect moment to strike. When its moment comes, it [b]pounces upon nearby enemies in a burst of blood and chaos[/b], instantly destroying them.

🐇 [b]Rabbit of Caerbannog Companion[/b]
Summons the infamous killer rabbit as a combat pet.
💀 [b]Monty Python Accurate Lethality[/b]
The rabbit [b]instantly kills enemies[/b] with savage pounces.
⏱ [b]Balanced Cooldown[/b]
The rabbit can attack [b]once every 5 seconds[/b], preventing constant screen wipes.
🎯 [b]Smart Targeting[/b]
Attacks enemies within [b]5 tiles[/b] of the player.
🩸 [b]Brutal Pounce Animation[/b]
Enemies are killed with a [b]violent pounce and blood splatter[/b], just like the film.
🌀 [b]Natural Companion Movement[/b]
The rabbit moves around you [b]like other companions[/b] (similar to the frog), staying nearby. 
💣 [b]Holy Hand Grenade Trinket[/b]
The trinket icon is styled after the [b]Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch[/b] in Stardew’s pixel style.

[b]How to Obtain:[/b]
This trinket is added to the [b]same drop pool as other trinkets[/b], meaning you can find it naturally while exploring dangerous areas such as:
[list]
[*]Skull Cavern[/*]
[*]Late-game combat areas[/*]
[*]Anywhere other trinkets may drop[/*]
[*]Buy from the Casino[/*]
[/list][b]Beware the Rabbit.[/b]
